# Song of Solomon Chapter 8 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**8:1** Who [mi] would-make-you [yittenekha] like-a-brother [ke-ach] to-me [li], who-nursed [yoneq] at-the-breasts [shaddei] of-my-mother [immi]? I-would-find-you [emtza'akha] outside [ba-chutz] and-I-would-kiss-you [eshshaqekha], and-none [gam lo] would-despise-me [yavuzu li].

**8:2** I-would-lead-you [enhagekha], I-would-bring-you [avi'akha] to the-house [el beit] of-my-mother [immi]; she-would-teach-me [telammedeni]. I-would-give-you-to-drink [ashqekha] from-wine [mi-yayin] of-the-spice [ha-reqach], from-the-juice [me-asis] of-my-pomegranate [rimmoni].

**8:3** His-left [smo'lo] [hand is] under my-head [tachat roshi], and-his-right [vi-mino] embraces-me [techabbeqeni].

**8:4** I-adjure-you [hishba'ti etkhem], daughters [benot] of-Jerusalem [Yerushalayim]: why [mah] will-you-stir [ta'iru] and-why [u-mah] will-you-awaken [te'oreru] love [et ha-ahavah] until [ad] she-pleases [she-techpatz]?

**8:5** Who [mi] [is] this [zot] coming-up [olah] from the-wilderness [min ha-midbar], leaning [mitrappeket] upon her-beloved [al dodah]? Under the-apple-tree [tachat ha-tappuach] I-awakened-you [orarticha]; there [shammah] your-mother [chavelatkha immekha] was-in-labor-with-you [chibblatekha], there [shammah] she-who-bore-you [yoladtekha] was-in-labor [chibbela].

**8:6** Set-me [simeni] like-a-seal [ka-chotam] upon your-heart [al libbeka], like-a-seal [ka-chotam] upon your-arm [al zero'ekha]; for strong [azzah] like-death [ka-mavet] [is] love [ahavah], fierce [qashah] like-Sheol [ki-She'ol] [is] jealousy [qin'ah]; its-flames [reshapeha] [are] flames [rishpei] of-fire [esh], a-flame-of-YAH [shalhevetyah].

**8:7** Many [rabbim] waters [mayim] cannot [lo yukhelu] quench [le-khabboth] love [et ha-ahavah], and-rivers [u-neharot] cannot [lo] drown-it [yishtefuha]. If a-man [ish] would-give [yitten] all [et kol] the-wealth [hon] of-his-house [beito] for-love [ba-ahavah], they-would-utterly-despise-him [boz yavuzu lo].

**8:8** We-have [lanu] a-little [qetannah] sister [achot], and-she-has-no [ve-shadayim ein] breasts [lah]. What shall-we-do [mah na'aseh] for-our-sister [la-achotenu] on-the-day [be-yom] when-she-is-spoken-for [she-yedubbar bah]?

**8:9** If she [im] [is] a-wall [chomah hi], we-will-build [nivneh] upon-her [aleha] a-battlement [tirat] of-silver [kasef]; and-if she [ve-im] [is] a-door [delet hi], we-will-enclose-her [natzur] with-boards [aleha lu'ach] of-cedar [erez].

**8:10** I [ani] [am] a-wall [chomah], and-my-breasts [ve-shadai] [are] like-towers [ke-migdalot]; then [az] I-was [hayiti] in-his-eyes [be-einav] like-one-who-finds [ke-motz'et] peace [shalom].

**8:11** Solomon [Shlomo] had [hayah] a-vineyard [kerem] in-Baal-Hamon [be-Ba'al Hamon]; he-gave [natan] the-vineyard [et ha-kerem] to-keepers [la-noterim]; each-one [ish] would-bring [yavi] for-its-fruit [be-firyo] a-thousand [elef] of-silver [kasef].

**8:12** My-vineyard [karmi], my-own [shelli], [is] before-me [lefanai]; the-thousand [ha-elef] [is] for-you [lekha], Solomon [Shlomo], and-two-hundred [u-matayim] for-those-who-keep [le-noterim] its-fruit [et piryo].

**8:13** O-you-who-dwell [ha-yoshevet] in-the-gardens [ba-gannim], companions [chaverim] are-listening [maqshivim] to-your-voice [le-qolekh]; let-me-hear [hashmi'ini] [it].

**8:14** Flee [berach], my-beloved [dodi], and-be-like [u-demeh lekha] a-gazelle [li-tzevi] or a-young [le-ofer] stag [ha-ayyalim] upon the-mountains [al harei] of-spices [vesamim].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.6 — "a flame of YAH" (shalhevetyah):** This compound word contains the divine name *YAH* (short form of YHWH). It may be a superlative ("a most vehement flame") or a literal theological claim: love is a flame that belongs to God. This is the only explicit reference to the divine name in the Song of Solomon.

**v.6 — "strong as death... fierce as Sheol":** Love and death are placed as equals — the two most powerful forces in human experience. The word *qin'ah* (jealousy/passion/zeal) carries both positive and negative connotations: fierce exclusive commitment.

**v.12 — "my vineyard is my own":** In contrast to Solomon's commercial vineyard (v.11), the woman's vineyard (her body, her love, her self) is her own to give. This is the Song's final statement of female autonomy.

*-- EMET*
